这一集里，几个人都特别在意自己在别人眼里是什么样子，最后反而把自己折腾得够呛。

Claire 去见一个十五年没见的老同事 Valerie。当年两个人事业起点差不多，后来 Claire 离开职场回家带孩子，Valerie 则一直留在公司。刚见面时，Claire 还下意识觉得 Valerie 肯定会羡慕自己有丈夫、有孩子。结果 Valerie 随口就开始讲自己四处旅行、在不同城市都有情人，而且马上还有机会拿下公司在巴黎的一个大职位。

等 Valerie 真拿到升职以后，Claire 的心态立刻反过来了。她开始觉得 Valerie 才是在可怜自己，于是非要把她请到家里，证明家庭生活有多美好。

可 Valerie 来得简直不能更不是时候。家里停水了，Luke 把回收活动收来的瓶子弄得到处都是，整个房子还一股酒味。Alex 在追一只老鼠。Haley 和 Dylan 在楼梯上吵得不可开交。Phil 为了卖房还在外面和一个便携厕所纠缠。Claire 本来想展示的“幸福家庭”，就这么当着 Valerie 的面一点点垮掉。

Valerie 走后，Claire 冲全家大发脾气，然后自己跑了出去。等她晚些时候回家，家里人正围着桌子一起吃东西。没人逼她道歉，也没人给她讲道理，只是很自然地给她腾了个位置。就是这么一个很安静的小场面，让 Claire 又想起自己当初为什么会选择这种生活。

另一边，Jay 勉强答应和 Cameron 去打壁球。Jay 一想到要跟一个 gay 男人一起在更衣室换衣服就很不自在，总觉得 Cameron 会用不同的眼光看自己。结果两个人换衣服时，光着的屁股不小心擦到了一下。Cameron 很随意地把这叫做一次“moon landing”。Jay 嘴上说没什么，脑子却彻底被这件事占据，连比赛都打不好了。

Jay 非要再比一场，这次终于赢了。回到更衣室，他还想证明自己已经完全不介意了，结果一转头才发现，站在自己身后的男人根本不是 Cameron。Jay 马上只想尽快离开。

Mitchell 也被 Gloria 搞得头疼。Gloria 出了车祸，Jay 让 Mitchell 以律师身份帮忙。Mitchell 还挺高兴，以为爸爸终于认可自己的专业能力。结果 Manny 悄悄告诉他，事故其实是 Gloria 的错。Jay 早就知道，他只是自己不敢告诉 Gloria，才把 Mitchell 推出去当挡箭牌。

Mitchell 还是硬着头皮去说了。Gloria 立刻炸毛，直接把他这个律师给“开除”了。后来她又回来，承认事故可能确实有自己一部分责任，然后再次请 Mitchell 帮忙——因为她居然已经又撞了一次。

到最后，Claire 的生活看起来依然比 Valerie 的混乱得多。只是她不再非得证明自己的生活更好。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is full of people worrying about how they look to someone else, and then making themselves miserable because of it.

Claire meets Valerie, an old coworker she hasn’t seen in fifteen years. Back then they were on the same career track, but Claire left work to raise a family while Valerie stayed with the company. At first Claire assumes Valerie must be jealous of her husband and kids. Then Valerie casually talks about traveling the world, having lovers in different cities, and possibly getting a huge promotion in Paris.

When Valerie gets the promotion, Claire suddenly feels like the one being judged. She convinces herself that Valerie pities her, so she invites her home to prove that family life is amazing.

Valerie could not arrive at a worse time. The water is shut off, Luke spills bags of bottles from his recycling drive, and the house smells like alcohol. Alex is chasing a rat. Haley and Dylan are fighting on the stairs. Phil is outside dealing with a portable toilet while trying to save a house sale. Claire watches the entire picture she wanted to show off fall apart in front of Valerie.

After Valerie leaves, Claire explodes at everyone and storms out. When she comes back later, the family is sitting around the table eating together. Nobody gives her a speech or demands an apology. They just make room for her. That quiet moment is enough to remind Claire why she chose this life in the first place.

Meanwhile, Jay agrees to play racquetball with Cameron. Jay is uncomfortable about changing in a locker room with a gay man and keeps imagining Cameron is going to look at him differently. Then, while they’re changing, their bare backsides accidentally touch. Cameron casually calls it a “moon landing.” Jay acts like it’s no big deal, but it completely gets into his head and ruins his game.

Jay demands a rematch and wins. Back in the locker room, he tries to prove he’s over the whole thing—then realizes the man standing behind him isn’t Cameron at all, and suddenly he wants out of there as fast as possible.

Mitchell has his own problem with Gloria. She’s been in a car accident, and Jay asks Mitchell to help because he’s a lawyer. Mitchell is pleased that his father finally seems to respect him professionally, until Manny quietly reveals that Gloria caused the accident. Jay already knew. He only brought Mitchell in because he didn’t want to be the one who told Gloria she was wrong.

Mitchell tries anyway. Gloria gets defensive and fires him. Later she comes back, admits the accident may have been partly her fault, and asks for his help again—because she has already had another accident.

By the end, Claire’s life still looks chaotic next to Valerie’s. She just stops needing it to look better.
